Yes, you can. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal and haven't used any benefits. Since it renewed this morning and you haven't used any benefits, you qualify.

If you use a benefit before cancelling (for example free shipping, a free change-of-mind return, or member pricing), you'd lose the refund, though benefits would continue to the end of the paid year. The policy excerpts I have don't say exactly where to cancel Leafy Plus or how long the refund takes to arrive. If you'd like, I can escalate to a Support Lead to confirm those details.
